reviewNote: Native16 variants only. Crops are at most16×16 except trees and genuinely tall world objects spanning multiple vertical cells; exceptions are labelled. No rescaling or RPG Maker upscales. Candidates are comparison-only, not applied game assets.

entries.name: Weathered barrel
entries.note: Muted brown and clear top rim fit neglected interiors. A smashed state still needs matching art.

entries.name: Timber crate
entries.note: Restrained warm wood; readable lid and compressed front. Compare with current loot visibility.

entries.name: Dark cave stone
entries.note: Small muted stone with a readable top. Fits neglected caves; mineral deposits still need explicit ore colour cues.

entries.name: Olive grass patch
entries.note: Muted olive works for unrestored ground. This soft-edged patch is a material sample, not a seamless replacement for the current painter. For school, pitch, golf or orchard rows this is base grass only; preserve chalk, mowing, litter and other role-specific overlays.

entries.name: Weathered earth patch
entries.note: Plain earth material; no visible furrows establish a tilled state.

entries.name: Copper-brown barrel
entries.note: Strong top rim and readable front. Brighter orange than the current world; best as a restored prop. One intact state only.

entries.name: Round broadleaf tree
entries.note: Clear canopy and trunk at small scale. Vivid green suits restored areas; 16px source clusters need scale review beside the 24px art target.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Leafy shrub
entries.note: Compact 16px leafy mound. Bright lime favours restored gardens; no harvest or damaged states selected.

entries.name: Red canopy tree study
entries.note: Useful fruit-tree silhouette and colour contrast, but this canopy has no explicit fruit; fruit and harvest states would need authoring.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Blue flower clump
entries.note: Readable pale blue bloom; colourful restored-garden option. A visual bloom alternative, not a verified botanical species.

entries.name: Light limestone stone
entries.note: Small pale rock with a clear top plane. More visible than the darker current stone; no ore markings.

entries.name: Warm cave spires
entries.note: Readable upright peaks with warm highlights. More saturated than Rogue; palette adjustment may be needed for bleak caves.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Red-roof cottage study
entries.note: Cozy restored palette and readable roof. 64×80 exceeds house target height; front is tall and role signage is absent.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Mint grass texture
entries.note: Clean square ground sample with bright mint tones. Best restored palette; tile seams need checking before replacing procedural terrain.

entries.name: Warm cave floor
entries.note: Fine orange grain offers a stone-floor alternative. More saturated than the current muted world; compare texture density at game scale.

entries.name: Quartz ore colour study
entries.note: Small mineral-flecked rock with a clear top plane. Colour study only: verify the gem colour language against inventory rewards before adoption; no mining depletion states included.

entries.name: Topaz ore colour study
entries.note: Small mineral-flecked rock with a clear top plane. Colour study only: verify the gem colour language against inventory rewards before adoption; no mining depletion states included.

entries.name: Steel-bound chest
entries.note: Cool iron edging and a clear lid suit dungeon loot. First frame shown; the source includes other chest states. Check its dark outline against the current world palette.

entries.name: Warm dungeon torch
entries.note: Small warm flame on a dark stand. Animation frames exist; luminosity and ground anchor still need review at actual game scale.

entries.name: Square olive tree
entries.note: Large flat canopy is readable and muted. Its square crown is a stronger stylization than current trees; compare the trunk and pixel size at game scale.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Clipped hedge cell
entries.note: Native 16px cell of the hedge top and front. This is a material study; connected corners and endings still need separate review.

entries.name: Cool stone grave marker
entries.note: Small carved upright stone. A material and silhouette alternative to the mossy grave pillar; moss and worn-state treatment would need matching.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Bright wooden notice board
entries.note: Compact legible notice board. Peach and mint accents suit restored locations; no readable game-specific lettering is included.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Ochre dungeon pot
entries.source: extra_assets/Dungeon Gathering Full Ver. 1.1/Break Update/All Vase Shine 16x16.png
entries.note: Explicit native 16×16 vase sheet. Warm earth colours and clear rim suit neglected rooms; animation and broken-state pairing still need review.

entries.name: Flat green grass ground
entries.note: Interior 16px ground cell without the raised border. Flat green gives a clean restored-park option; compare material detail with the current grass. For school, pitch, golf or orchard rows this is base grass only; preserve chalk, mowing, litter and other role-specific overlays.

entries.name: Pixel Plains grass tuft
entries.note: Thin upright blades offer a readable grass silhouette. Current longgrass is named Fern, so this is a grass study rather than a botanical match.

entries.name: Muted grass tuft
entries.note: Olive blades fit neglected ground and the restrained palette. Grass silhouette differs from the current Fern identity; review before assigning it.

entries.name: Bright grass tuft
entries.note: A leaf-only native 16px tuft, without the flower in the earlier sample. Saturated green suits restored ground; differs from the current Fern identity.

entries.name: Blue inset switch
entries.note: Small blue inset button. Control alternative only: current lever silhouette and state feedback would need adapting.

entries.name: Blue dungeon floor plate
entries.note: Flat patterned cell has a clear rim. Material alternative only; needs separate pressed state and the game’s cyan puzzle cue.

entries.name: Green inset floor button
entries.note: A green inset control with strong colour cue. Match pressed/unpressed behaviour and keep its silhouette readable against floor tiles.

entries.name: Red inset floor button
entries.note: Contrasting red activation cue on blue stone. Review whether red implies hazard rather than the main puzzle plate.

entries.name: Blue glass bottle
entries.note: Rounded glass container with a small stopper. Strong highlights read well; preserve the intended bottle contents and item/map consistency.

entries.name: Blue square paving
entries.note: Quiet stone square with a darker central motif. Suitable indoor paving study; repeat seams and contrast need review.

entries.name: Rose square paving
entries.note: Warm counterpart to the blue paving. Fits restored interiors; does not encode building status by itself.

entries.name: Red-roof smithy
entries.note: Recognizable smithy sign and broad roof. Tall building exception, but exceeds the 64px house target: would need reauthoring, not downscaling, before adoption.

entries.name: Dark mossy grass
entries.note: Deep desaturated green suits forest, wetland and neglected churchyard grass. Base material study; water sheen and leaf litter remain separate concerns.

entries.name: Bare swamp tree
entries.note: Twisted bare branches support neglected landscapes. Keep living/restored trees distinct; camera is upright and front-heavy.
entries.sizeException: Tall world object spanning more than one vertical 16px cell; original pixels preserved.

entries.name: Cool metal lamp post
entries.note: Tall simple lamp silhouette; current lighting stays separate. Palette is cool and clean, so weathered/broken states would need matching.

entries.name: Red mushroom study
entries.note: Bold compact cap and pale stem. Thick outline is more graphic than current world art; compare at actual item size.

entries.name: Blue rippling water
entries.note: Native16 interior water sample. One animation phase only; animated seams and pier overlays remain part of the current renderer.

entries.name: Orange lava surface
entries.note: Native16 interior lava texture with bright cellular highlights. One animation phase; preserve hazard readability and lighting separately.

entries.name: Plain pale sand
entries.note: Interior sample without the outer border. Suitable sand or restored path material; current roads need soft blended edges rather than a hard tile border.

entries.name: Grained sand
entries.note: Pale granular counterpart to plain sand. Useful weathered path texture study; preserve current continuous road geometry and edge blending.

entries.name: Warm stone paving
entries.note: Native16 square temple paving. Restrained warm stone could suit restored hard surfaces; road edge blending remains separate.

entries.name: Worn rose paving
entries.note: A darker stone material for weathered hard surfaces. Warm purple may need palette matching; no procedural road geometry is replaced by this sample.

entries.name: Dark timber floor
entries.note: Vertical planking with restrained warm browns. Check repeat seams and apparent plank width at gameplay scale.

entries.name: Small sanctuary candle
entries.note: Warm flame on a pale base. A compact ritual-light alternative; current illumination and shrine meaning stay separate.

entries.name: Wood fence cell study
entries.note: Small timber fence cell rather than sharpened stakes. Material study only; hazard silhouettes and charred treatment would need reauthoring.

entries.name: Warm cave spires · narrow

entries.note: Native16 complete chest with restrained brown wood and gold latch. Closed/open companions are separately shown; match the game’s chest state mapping before adoption.

entries.name: Open marsh chest
entries.note: Native16 complete chest with restrained brown wood and gold latch. Closed/open companions are separately shown; match the game’s chest state mapping before adoption.

entries.name: Flat green grass
entries.note: Clean saturated green suits restored ground. For pitch/golf/school this is base grass only; retain functional markings and texture overlays.

entries.name: Clover grass
entries.note: Small light-green leaf clusters add a welcoming grass texture. Brighter than the muted current world; review repetition and density.

entries.name: Mottled grass
entries.note: Dark scattered clumps distinguish the surface from flat grass. It lacks wetland water sheen; a ground material study only.

entries.name: Warm sand grain
entries.note: Small ochre flecks on pale sand. Interior material sample; preserve continuous road geometry and soft path edges.

entries.name: Soft cyan water
entries.note: Gentle broad water ripples. One surface sample only; animation and pier overlays still need matching.

entries.name: Circular tilled soil
entries.note: Small dark soil depression with a rim. Compare plot shape with the current square planting layout before adoption.

entries.name: Small timber barrel
entries.note: Compact complete barrel with pale bands. Larger barrels on this sheet exceed16px and were not used; break state still needs a companion.

entries.name: Stone grave cross
entries.note: Clear tiny grave cross with cool shading. Shape alternative to the mossy grave marker; add moss or neglect treatment if needed.

entries.name: Rounded gravestone
entries.note: Compact cool-grey tombstone with an inset marking. One complete16px object; worn and mossy versions are not selected.

entries.name: Pale small stone
entries.note: A complete loose stone with a broad lit top. Strong highlight suits restored areas; no embedded ore markings.

entries.name: Dark small stone
entries.note: Tiny blue-grey stone offers a flint colour study. Species/material identity needs matching before adopting for mineable flint.

entries.name: Cyan crystal stone
entries.note: Small cyan rock with a bright face. A single stone differs from a cluster; no automatic gem reward identity is implied.

entries.name: Gold-edged chest
entries.note: Compact complete chest with bright gold bands. Strong reward visibility; source also provides opening companions.

entries.name: Open gold-edged chest
entries.note: Open-state companion to the closed chest. A complete16px sprite; verify frame order against current loot state.

entries.name: Blue ceramic bottle
entries.note: Complete blue vessel with a small lip. More ceramic than glass; use only if the item material and world silhouette remain coherent.

entries.name: Orange clay pot
entries.note: Small rounded pot with a bright rim. Broad warm colour reads well; matching broken-state art is not selected.

entries.name: Round orange pot
entries.note: Second complete pottery silhouette from the same sheet. Compare size and contents with the current intact pot.

entries.name: Small red rug
entries.note: A complete small square rug, not a crop of a larger carpet. Red diagonal weave is a close colour-family match.

entries.name: Small wooden table
